description: Exact repro of the reported production bug: a confident, complete-sounding architecture description that never actually states any component's lifecycle status. The old classifier wrongly answered these as 'unchanged'. This case pins that regression down permanently.

questions.question: What is the lifecycle status of the frontend application: new, modified, removed, or unchanged?
What is the lifecycle status of the backend API: new, modified, removed, or unchanged?
What is the lifecycle status of the database: new, modified, removed, or unchanged?
